title: Relational Preference Encoding in Looped Transformer Internal States
reasoning: The paper focuses on the mechanistic interpretability of how preference signals are geometrically encoded within the hidden states of a looped transformer. While it uses the Anthropic HH-RLHF (Helpful and Harmless) dataset, which contains ethical/moral judgments, the study itself is an architectural and representation analysis rather than a benchmarking of ethics, morals, or religious values.
